iv-access-allowlists: JS/e2e hook — element carries data-iv-access-allowlists; picker-field children styled
iv-advanced: <details> 'Advanced restock settings' disclosure — native disclosure chrome, field children styled
iv-agent-revoke: JS hook on styled .iv-btn--danger (agent-access.js token row revoke, delegated click)
iv-agent-rotate: JS hook on styled .iv-btn--ghost (agent-access.js token row rotate, delegated click)
iv-app--denied: state modifier on styled .iv-app canvas (access-denied page)
iv-badge--neutral: explicit neutral badge variant — intentionally resolves to base .iv-badge pill (no accent)
iv-badge--ok: semantic status marker on styled .iv-badge — active/returned loans render the neutral base pill by design
iv-checkbox__input: redundant marker — input already styled via .iv-checkbox input
iv-import-headers: JS/e2e hook — element carries data-iv-import-headers; contents styled
iv-import-result: aria-live result host — element carries data-iv-import-result; contents styled
iv-item-cf: custom-fields host container — field children styled via .iv-field
iv-label-print: styled by the self-contained <style> block in templates/label-print.php (print surface ships no app.css)
iv-label-print__code: styled by the self-contained <style> block in templates/label-print.php
iv-label-print__sheet: styled by the self-contained <style> block in templates/label-print.php
iv-label-print__toolbar: styled by the self-contained <style> block in templates/label-print.php
iv-label-sheet: styled by the self-contained <style> block in templates/label-sheet-print.php
iv-label-sheet__count: styled by the self-contained <style> block in templates/label-sheet-print.php
iv-label-sheet__toolbar: styled by the self-contained <style> block in templates/label-sheet-print.php
iv-movements-results: JS mount hook — queried as #iv-movements-results; table contents styled
iv-section__body: content host inside styled .iv-section — contents styled
iv-stocktake-save-status: save-status text node — carries .iv-muted; class is the JS update hook
iv-stocktake-table-host: mount host for styled stocktake table
iv-table--cards: cards-variant marker on styled .iv-table; mobile card transform via .iv-table td[data-cell]::before (app recipe)
